description: This Java class defines the ShutdownBehaviour, an Akka actor behavior responsible for managing shutdown commands triggered by messages such as Shutdown. It handles subscribing to a pub/sub system and shutting down the actor when a relevant Shutdown message is received.

classes.name: ShutdownBehaviour
classes.description: Final class that encapsulates the Actor's shutdown behavior, including pub/sub subscription and message handling for Shutdown commands.

methods.name: fromId
methods.description: Factory method to create ShutdownBehaviour with entity ID and pub/sub mediator, deriving namespace from entity ID.

methods.name: fromIdWithoutNamespace
methods.description: Factory method to create ShutdownBehaviour with entity ID (without namespace).

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates an Akka ReceiveBuilder that defines how to handle incoming messages.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Handles a Shutdown message; shuts down the actor if the reason is relevant for the namespace or entity.

methods.name: subscribeAck
methods.description: Handles subscription acknowledgment messages; currently does nothing.
